scene: The bell jar unlocks a roof terrace bustling with sky transports.
picture: A flat side-view pixel skyport terrace atop the tower. On the far left sits a red double-decker hover bus. In the centre, a tethered gondola drone bobs gently. Next to it stands grandmother in her pink tracksuit holding her white dog. On the far right waits an ornate, horse-shaped hover carriage.
